arithmetic_contract: Load the same pinned BF16-stored backbone values into FP32 storage for both methods. Disable autocast for native factor generation/export, losses, choice scoring and full-logit probes, including original floors, every saved checkpoint and target evaluation. Record actual floating parameter/buffer and raw-logit dtypes. Gates, ranks, alpha/r scaling, initialization factors, fixtures, model revisions and training hyperparameters remain unchanged.
gradient_contract: Separate token-normalized current/reference gradients; combine g_current + replay_weight * g_reference before one global norm clip and one AdamW step. Replay-off computes and discards reference gradients. Retain shared-core or LoRA Adam state, with old native vectors and their optimizer state frozen.
initialization_contract: All three native vectors clone published RTE. Persistent LoRA embeds the same effective RTE factors at ranks q=36/v=37 with nonzero extra A directions and zero extra B directions, preserving alpha/r=2. The fixed pretraining numerical gate uses validation-only native/LoRA choice scores and probes. Posttraining test floors reload the untouched raw backbone and original saved native/LoRA initial checkpoints, including the original task-vector state; trained state is never an initial floor.
ownership: experiments/portability/**; parent alone owns resources, runtime gates, queue and GPU dispatch
pending_proof: One parent-owned validation-only zero-update GPU qualification with unchanged numerical gates
Only after qualification passes: parent may launch the same four configurations with fresh IDs
Paired primary results before any reserved fixture419 confirmation decision
prior_runs: Earlier Amber and catalog results remain in their immutable outputs and source bundles. This canonical handoff now describes only the new repeated sequence.

qualification_launch_plan.execution: prepare, validation-only initialization, fresh-process original-initial checkpoint reload, then exit
qualification_launch_plan.success_requirement: Existing unchanged initialization and reload gates pass on the pinned GPU runtime.

routing: Both methods receive the identical explicit task name in each prompt. Native additionally selects the known task vector. One persistent LoRA remains installed for all tasks and boundaries. No unknown-task retrieval claim.

runtime_dependency.scope: Parent-owned original 8B runtime smoke; per-arm numerical parity remains required before sequence training.

scientific_limitations: One procedural digit-permutation family and known task routing; four-choice accuracy rather than free generation.
Matched active scalar count and data schedules do not establish identical function dimension, optimization geometry or FLOPs.
Descriptive paired intervals concern held-out input groups within one fixture, not training-seed uncertainty or confirmed method superiority.
Source acquisition and zero-calibration 8B-to-1.7B transfer are separate measured claims.

table_evidence.capacity: CPU published-model shape plan; actual PEFT counts and serialized checkpoint tensor sizes must be verified in runner receipts before comparing learning.
table_evidence.counting: Adapter checkpoint tensor counts exclude the common frozen 8B backbone and separately serialized optimizer state. Native full checkpoint includes frozen alignment and 17 task-vector rows. Active native count includes the core plus only the current 256-scalar vector.
table_evidence.exposure: Planned schedules, not GPU execution counts. Current/reference supervised, input and padded token counts plus actual ordered-row hashes are required at runtime.
table_evidence.native_checkpoint_count_source: outputs/inspection/sdk_receipt.json: original 8B artifact 31,120,000 scalars plus 3 x 256 new vector scalars.

test_isolation_contract: Training reads only current/past train and validation splits plus metadata-only initialization receipts. Test rows, labels, predictions and scores are evaluated only after all training has finished. CPU heldout-mutation counterexamples must preserve exact learned model and optimizer state and verify original initial-floor checkpoint identity.
torch_install_rule: Keep the image vendor ROCm Torch; constrain its installed version during uv installation.
